asr.full_text: hello this is a tutorial on how to buy BNB and Binance for beginners in 2026 BNB which stands for Binance coin is the native cryptocurrency of the Binance exchange people use BNB to pay trading fees at a discount participate in token launches and use apps in the BNB chain ecosystem here is how to buy BNB on Binance as a beginner first, create a Binance account if you do not already have one go the Binance website or download the Binance app, click register and Sign up with your email you will need to verify your email and complete identity verification to unlock full trading features Once your account is setup, you need to add funds. Click buy crypto at the top of the screen. You can deposit funds using a debit card, credit card, or bank transfer. Follow the prompts to complete your deposit. After depositing, go to the markets or trade section and search for BNB. You can buy BNB quickly using the buy crypto feature, which lets you purchase with your card or balance in just a few clicks. Select BNB from the list of available cryptocurrencies, enter the amount in dollars you want to spend, and review the estimated BNB you will receive. Confirm the purchase. Your BNB will appear in your Binance spot wallet within seconds. You can view your balance in the Wallet section of the app or website. From there you can hold BNB, use it to pay trading fees, or withdraw it to an external wallet for use in other applications. Thanks for watching.
